verdict.rationale: Crossmint is a wallet/payments infrastructure API for agents, not itself an agent, but the evidence contains no mention of an official MCP server offering — all APIs are REST/SDK based (agent cards, wallets, checkouts). Since Crossmint is a service provider (not an agent), an MCP server would be a plausible axis, but there is zero evidence of one; however this story specifically concerns 'connecting an agent via an MCP server' which for a payments infrastructure product without any MCP-server evidence should be judged as no capability shown.
